Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delineaâs leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle â across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities â including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines â assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real-time. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.

Job Summary 

This position is on the team building StrongDM, now part of Delineaâthe universal access management platform that secures and audits access to databases, servers, Kubernetes clusters, and web applications. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will apply deep expertise across distributed systems, security, and cloud architecture to help shape the technical direction of StrongDMâs proxy and control-plane platform. You will take on the platformâs most complex and ambiguous engineering challenges, exercise independent judgment on architecture and design decisions that span multiple teams, and serve as a recognized subject matter expert on secure, high-scale distributed systems written in Go. You will report to the teamâs engineering manager.

What Youâll Do:

- Lead the architecture and technical direction of highly concurrent, distributed backend systems in Go (Golang), setting engineering standards that extend across multiple teams within StrongDM and Delinea.

- Drive design decisions for the proxy data plane (gateways and relays) and control-plane services, evaluating tradeoffs on the platformâs most complex and ambiguous technical problems.

- Partner with architects, product managers, and DevOps/SRE leadership to shape multi-quarter system roadmaps, translating broader business priorities into concrete technical strategy.

- Serve as a subject matter expert on secure network protocols and cryptographic systems (TLS/mTLS, credential brokering, key management), guiding their application across the platform.

- Lead code and design reviews across teams, holding a high bar for performance, security, and maintainability, and coach engineers on applying that bar independently.

- Investigate and resolve the most challenging technical issues in distributed, multi-cloud production environments, often requiring evaluation of ambiguous or intangible tradeoffs.

- Author and maintain architectural and technical strategy documentation that informs decisions beyond your immediate team.

- Mentor engineers across the team and may direct the work of others, building the cross-team relationships that help align engineering execution with company objectives.

What Youâll Need: 

- Bachelorâs or Masterâs degree in computer science, software engineering, or related technical discipline.

- 8+ years of professional experience working as a software engineer, with deep expertise in Go (Golang) , distributed systems, and backend/network service development at scale.

- Demonstrated experience architecting highly concurrent, distributed systems and exercising independent judgment on methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria, including Goâs standard networking and cryptography libraries.

- Strong understanding of distributed systems, network protocols, and API design (gRPC/Protobuf and/or RESTful APIs), with the ability to reason about tradeoffs across an entire system.

- Experience with AWS (or another major cloud provider) and cloud-native deployment models at production scale.

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to convey advanced technical concepts and persuade diverse stakeholders and audiences.

- Proven ability to build formal working relationships and coordinate across multiple teams and functions.

- Conceptual thinking skills sufficient to understand advanced technical issues and their broader implications for the business.

- Demonstrated track record mentoring engineers and being recognized as a subject matter expert others turn to for guidance.

Weâd Love to See: 

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) beyond a single provider.

- Experience establishing or influencing engineering-wide standards for Terraform automation and CI/CD pipelines.

- Deep expertise with secure protocols, mTLS and PKI, secrets management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault), and credential brokering.

- Experience shaping Zero Trust architecture strategy, just-in-time access models, and policy-as-code (e.g., Cedar) at an organizational level.

title: Senior Software Engineer Case Execution
description:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About the Role 

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do 

- Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

- Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

- Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

- Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.

- Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.

Who You Are 

- 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus

- Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems

- Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter

- Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve

- Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment

- Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight

- Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams

Extra Credit If You Have 

- Experience with healthcare-specific data or HealthTech systems

- Exposure to data-heavy architectures or problems adjacent to data engineering without being a pure data engineer

- Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks

- Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions

Why Youâll Love Working Here 

Weâre a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubsâLos Angeles and New Yorkâwe remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If youâre excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, weâd love to hear from you .

Benefits Include: 

- Competitive compensation, including equity

- Full health, dental, and vision coverage

- Retirement savings plan through 401(k)

- Flexible time off

- Opportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?
Weâre building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and letâs transform healthcare reimbursement together .

Employment Information 

Work Authorization 

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

Equal Employment Opportunity 

Pivotal Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Reasonable Accommodations 

Pivotal Health provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you need assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Background Checks 

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable background checks, where permitted by law.

At-Will Employment 

Employment with Pivotal Health is at-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law.

Education and Experience

- Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

- Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions. 
- Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others. 
- Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems. 

Physical Requirements:

- Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory. 
- The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively. 
- The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential. 
- Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment. 
- Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling. 
- The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.

title: Head of Security
location: New York, New York, New York, United States
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering , Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

- Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security. 
- Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation. 
- Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do. 
- Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
- Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it. 
- Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team. 

What You'll Bring

- Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth. 
- Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook. 
- An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code. 
- Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling. 
- Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you. 
- Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus. 
- Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus. 

What's Cool About The Role

- You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team. 
- A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders. 
- We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it. 
- Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity. 
- Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas. 
- Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook. 

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

Reports To: Director, Support Operations

Position Summary

The Clinical Coordinator Department Manager oversees the Clinical Coordination team responsible for maintaining accurate, appropriately filled provider schedules across all markets. This role provides leadership, operational oversight, training, workload management, process improvement, and cross-department collaboration to support consistent scheduling performance.

This leader sets daily and weekly priorities, delegates work, holds the team accountable, monitors current and upcoming schedule health, and identifies risks before they impact provider days. The manager ensures accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked and that scheduling barriers are tracked and escalated to the appropriate owner.

Team Leadership & Performance Management

- Lead, mentor, and develop Clinical Coordinators through clear priorities, delegation, accountability, and follow-through

- Oversee team scheduling, workload balancing, and coverage across markets based on provider days, appointment volume, and overall workload
- Support onboarding and competency development for new team members
- Foster a positive, efficient, and collaborative culture grounded in service excellence and ownership

Appointment Readiness & Schedule Reliability

- Monitor the 0-14-day schedule and upcoming weeks to identify open capacity, underfilled provider days, and scheduling risks early
- Ensure accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked in accordance with provider availability, market zoning, and scheduling priorities
- Ensure Clinical Coordinators identify, track, and escalate scheduling barriers, including outstanding medical clearances, insurance verification, pre-medication needs, facility documentation, and lab-case concerns, to the appropriate department or owner
- Monitor Clinical Days at Goal and schedule disruptions to ensure timely follow-up and improve filled provider days across applicable markets
- Ensure schedules are entered timely and accurately while production-based scheduling remains focused appropriately

Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement

- Analyze recurring scheduling barriers, backlog trends, fall-aparts, and schedule-health concerns to identify operational gaps and root causes
- Develop preventive strategies and implement workflow or SOP improvements within Clinical Coordination
- Coordinate any workflow change affecting another department or external partner with the appropriate department leader or Account Manager before implementation
- Support system optimization, automation initiatives, and process refinements in CareStack and Healier

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner across departments to resolve scheduling barriers, maintain clear ownership, and support consistent patient flow
- Serve as an escalation point for complex scheduling needs or facility and provider concerns
- Independently address department concerns, communicate risks and updates, and escalate to the Director when additional leadership support is needed

Data, Reporting & Accountability

- Monitor and report team performance and operational health indicators, including:
- Clinical Days at Goal

- Accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlog progress
- Schedule-entry timeliness

Qualifications

- Experience: 5+ years in dental, medical, or clinical scheduling/coordination; minimum 2 years leadership experience
- Systems: Experience with CareStack, or similar EMR platforms and Google Suite required
- Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical/dental workflows, provider scheduling, multi-facility coordination, pre-med & medical clearance processes, insurance verification, lab case coordination, and multi-facility scheduling
- Leadership: Demonstrated success managing remote teams, assigning and delegating work, coaching performance, holding employees accountable, and implementing process improvements. 
- Skills:
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
- Strong organizational, delegation, and prioritization abilities
- Ability to independently assess problems, make decisions, and follow through
- Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment

Key Competencies

- Leadership & team development
- Delegation, accountability & follow-through
- Proactive problem solving & root-cause thinking
- Schedule-health oversight & workload management
- Workflow optimization & accuracy
- Efficient decision-making & prioritization
- Cross-functional collaboration

The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. - Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
- Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
- Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
- Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
- Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
- Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.

- A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.

How we work
We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers - A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
- Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
- Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
- The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
- Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Investment Director (Diagnostics) - Lyon, France
description:
Location : Lyon, France

ABOUT ARCHIMED 

With offices in Europe, the US and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare. Our mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise positions us as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Priority areas include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools and Biologic Services, MedTech and Pharma Services. ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services.

ARCHIMED manages $11 billion across its funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based GP. MED I, MED II and MED Platform I are all top-decile performers for their vintage according to Preqin data. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

THE TEAM

- An global team with complementary backgrounds across investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational disciplines.
- Alumni of INSEAD, Wharton, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, École des Ponts ParisTech, ESSEC, Imperial College and Dartmouth, among others.
- Professional backgrounds spanning Private Equity (3i, Siparex, USS Ltd, Barings, Capiton, Partners Group, KKR), Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), M&A (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC, Goldman Sachs, Jefferies) and Industry (Biotronik, Cerba, Stryker, Phillips, Pfizer, Baxter, LivaNova, J&J, Galderma, Sanofi).

THE DIAGNOSTICS TEAM 

The Director will serve as a senior investment professional with direct responsibility for sourcing, evaluating and executing investments across the Diagnostics portfolio. The Director will lead deal activity across an assigned geography, technology platform or investment theme, and will carry accountability for investment outcomes, value creation and portfolio company support.

This is a senior operating role combining strategic direction setting with hands-on deal execution, positioning the Director as a trusted senior advisor to Partners and portfolio management teams.

- Investment Sourcing & Strategy 
- Drive sourcing and pipeline development across assigned Diagnostics sectors or geographies, identifying and cultivating relationships with sellers, intermediaries and LP co-investors.
- Lead the formation and evolution of investment theses within assigned focus areas, including category mapping, competitive positioning and market trend analysis.
- Serve as primary investment decision maker and deal sponsor, with direct accountability for investment committee presentations and recommendation.
- Lead the negotiation of transaction terms, pricing and deal structure in partnership with Partners and external advisors.
- Due Diligence & Execution 
- Oversee comprehensive commercial, financial and operational due diligence, working with external advisors to validate assumptions and identify key risks and levers.
- Lead the development of post-acquisition value creation roadmaps, including 100-day plans and multi-year operating strategies.
- Manage the investment committee approval process and coordinate all transaction closing mechanics with legal and finance teams.
- Portfolio Leadership & Value Creation 
- Serve as the primary investment relationship owner for assigned portfolio companies, working directly with management teams on strategy, M&A, capital deployment and operational priorities.
- Lead add-on acquisition identification, evaluation and execution, including syndication with co-investors.
- Drive performance monitoring and problem-solving, escalating key decisions to Partners and intervention areas to senior management.
- Sponsor and mentor portfolio company boards, ensuring robust governance and strategic clarity.
- Team & Platform Development 
- Mentor and develop Senior Analysts and Associate-level team members, contributing to talent development and succession planning within the Diagnostics function.
- Contribute to ARCHIMED's Diagnostics thought leadership and external positioning through conference participation, investor communication and industry engagement.
- Identify and build capabilities across the Diagnostics platform to support scaling and evolution of the investment program.
Requirements 

- 8 to 12 years of investment or operating experience, with a strong track record in private equity investing, transaction execution or operational leadership within diagnostics sector.
- Demonstrated success originating, evaluating and closing significant investments (€50 million+ enterprise value preferred), with evidence of value creation across the portfolio.
- Deep expertise in the Diagnostics landscape, including brand strategy, omnichannel distribution, and regulatory dynamics .
- Exceptional executive presence and communication skills. Able to command credibility with sophisticated management teams, institutional LPs and external partners.
- Strong financial acumen and fluency with investment modeling, valuation and deal structuring. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills required.
- Proven operational judgment and the ability to translate market insights into concrete investment theses and deal opportunities.
- Track record of building and leading high-performing teams. Comfort with mentoring junior professionals and shaping investment culture.
- Strategic, entrepreneurial and partnership-minded. Takes ownership of outcomes, moves with pace and brings a builder's orientation to platform development.
- Advanced degree preferred. MBA or equivalent experience strongly valued.
- Embodies and reinforces ARCHIMED's cultural values of inclusion, meritocracy, partnership, accountability, client focus and trust.

title: Bauleiter:in (Neubau & Revitalisierung)
description:
BAULEITER:IN (NEUBAU & REVITALISIERUNG)

Einsatzgebiet: Münster (+50 km) & Düsseldorf (+100 km)

Du bringst fundierte Bauerfahrung mit und möchtest Deine Expertise dort einsetzen, wo sie Wirkung entfaltet? Dann freuen wir uns auf Dich.

Wir entwickeln Immobilien mit gesellschaftlicher Relevanz: Seniorenwohnen, Pflegeimmobilien und neue Konzepte für das Wohnen & Leben im Alter. Unser Anspruch: Wir wollen das Wohnen und Leben im Alter maßgeblich verändern.

Wir entwickeln neue Wohnformen von Tiny Living bis urbanem Wohnen – vom ländlichen Konzept für das Mittelstand bis zur gehobenen urbanen Wohnanlage. Wir bauen auf dem Land und in der Stadt, neu und im Bestand, und schaffen bezahlbare Wohnangebote mit Service und Betreuung für die Mitte der Gesellschaft.

Dafür gehen wir neue Wege und denken Prozesse und Verfahren neu: vom modularen Bauen über Standardisierung und Individualisierung bis zur Skalierung – unter Einsatz neuester Technologien.

Dafür suchen wir Dich: Bauleiter:in (m/w/d)

Eine Persönlichkeit, die die technische Verantwortung übernimmt: neue Bauweisen versteht, fundiert bewertet und auf der Baustelle umsetzt – im Neubau wie im Bestand, in einem jungen, agilen und digital arbeitenden Team.

Wir bauen zukunftsorientiert – agil, digital und effizient.

Wenn Du Bauprozesse weiterentwickeln und digitale Werkzeuge konsequent einsetzen möchtest, bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Deine Rolle:

- Technische Verantwortung für Neubau- und Revitalisierungsprojekte – vom ersten Spatenstich bis zur Übergabe

- Technische Bewertung neuer Bauweisen, Systeme und Technologien – vom modularen bis zum seriellen Bauen

- Mitwirkung an einheitlichen technischen Standards (z. B. wiederkehrende Grundrisse, Bauteile und Ausstattungen), die wir an vielen Standorten umsetzen

- Steuerung von Ausschreibung und Bauausführung inkl. Koordination der Gewerke und Nachunternehmer

- Technische Prüfung von Bestandsimmobilien auf bauliche Machbarkeit – als Grundlage für die Projektentwicklung

- Sicherstellung von Qualität, Kosten und Terminen auf der Baustelle – in enger Abstimmung mit der Projektentwicklung

- Digitale Baustelle: Bautagebuch, Mängel- und Terminmanagement – papierlos und datenbasiert

Was uns wichtig ist:

Wir suchen keinen klassischen Konzern-Bauleiter. Wir suchen Menschen mit Ambition, Gestaltungswillen und Umsetzungsstärke, die:

- fundierte Erfahrung in Neubau und Bauen im Bestand mitbringen (Umbau, Sanierung, Revitalisierung)

- Erfahrung mit modularem und seriellem Bauen bzw. Sanieren haben – oder dieses Thema aktiv in Projekte einbringen möchten

- digitale Lösungen im Bau schätzen und Bauprozesse moderner, effizienter und datenbasiert gestalten wollen

- Projekte auch in komplexen Situationen zielsicher zum Abschluss bringen

title: (Senior) Programmatic Sales GSA
description:
YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND 

The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want. 

Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. THE ROLE 

As a Programmatic Sales GSA, you will be responsible for the automated and data-driven sale of our digital advertising inventory (primarily video and CTV) and report directly to the Director Sales All Markets. You will manage programmatic bookings, oversee the planning, implementation and optimisation of our initiatives to boost revenue in programmatic sales, and will therefore also be directly responsible for the optimisation and smooth, technical implementation of campaigns. This makes you the primary point of contact for agency trading desks in the GSA region regarding preferred deals and PMP strategies. You’ll also help with SSP and header bidding integrations and act as the link between Sales, Tech and AdOps.

THE ADS TEAM 

The Ads Team is a small but highly efficient team that combines technology and marketing to win customers over in the long term. With a presence in two countries (based in Berlin, Hamburg and Zurich) and operations in six countries, the Ads Team is a key driver of growth within Zattoo and has established itself as the market leader in CTV in Switzerland within a year.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Acquisition of new customers, advice, support and guide media agencies, trading desks and direct clients through our programmatic possibilities in a way they can understand.

- Drawing up and negotiating bespoke programme packages, private deals or preferred deals.

- Maximise inventory revenue, skilfully manage floor prices (minimum prices) and analyse delivery rates and CPMs.

- Partner with regional sales teams in GSA to consult clients and pitch programmatic solutions.

- Co-lead the technical and commercial setup of Header Bidding and additional SSP integrations for CTV.

- First-line technical ownership of programmatic delivery.

- Identify technical errors during delivery, analyse tracking issues and check campaign set-ups: troubleshoot deal delivery, floor pricing, and DSP configuration issues (e.g., SSAI, VAST responses, pod management, DSP/SSP bid stream mismatches).

- Explain complex technical matters in simple terms to non-technical customers or internal departments.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- 4+ years of experience in Programmatic Advertising, SSP Management, or Programmatic Account Management (strong experience in CTV/Video)

- A proven track record in the sales of digital advertising products

- Deep understanding of Google Ad Manager, DSP/SSP workflows, OpenRTB specs, and deal types (Preferred Deals, PMP, PG)

- Experience or strong technical familiarity with Header Bidding frameworks (e.g., Prebid) and SSP integrations

- Strong network or understanding of the DACH Agency Trading Desk landscape

- Fluent in German and English

- Independent, strong communicator, able to work under pressure, with strong negotiation skills

- Teamplayer and creative thinker with a questioning mindset.

WHY JOIN US? 

At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

- Reward : strong market competitive salary

- Recharge : 30 days vacation plus public holidays

- Regulate : trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year

Plus:

- We’re sharing: Free access to the best streaming experience on the market

- We're developing: Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days

- We’re inclusive: ‘ Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities

- We’re healthy: Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!

- We’re responsible: We are carbon neutral, an active employee Green team, discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals

- We’re sociable: A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event

Zattoo enables our users to view indiscriminately and we reflect that in our team too. Regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law we encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunities employer — join us and help build a diverse team dedicated to revolutionising the way you watch TV.

We are committed to ensuring fair, open, and equitable hiring practices and are happy to answer any questions you may have about us or the role throughout the whole process. title: Performance Ad Creative – Static & Video
description:
Die Rolle

Du bist Performance Ad Creative in unserem Growth Team. Unsere Performance-Agentur steuert Strategie, Testplan und Media Buying auf Meta und TikTok. Du baust die Ads: Statics und Video, Hooks und Varianten, in wöchentlichen Sprints. Aus jedem Gewinner machst du die nächste Generation.

Dafür verbindest du Daten mit Kreativität. Du weißt, was im E-Commerce gerade funktioniert, liest die Zahlen deiner Ads und machst daraus die nächste Idee. Du entwickelst und produzierst selbst, von Konzept und Skript bis zum fertigen Asset.

Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Brand und Performance: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Creative Direction zusammen, nutzt die Bildwelt der Marke als Fundament und sorgst dafür, dass Qstar auch in schnellen Ads erkennbar bleibt. Im Growth Team arbeitest du mit Shop Lead, Creator Marketing und Organic Social zusammen und berichtest regelmäßig, welche Ads laufen, was gewinnt und was als Nächstes getestet wird.

Was du machst

- Du baust unsere Performance-Creative-Pipeline auf: von Idee und Briefing über Produktion bis Test und Auswertung, als wiederholbaren Prozess.

- Du arbeitest in Wochensprints: jede Woche neue Ads in den Test, müde Ads werden ersetzt.

- Du entwickelst eigene Konzepte, Hooks und Formate für Meta und TikTok und baust Static- und Video-Ads selbst.

- Du liest Hook Rate, Hold Rate, Watch Time, CTR, CPM, Conversion Rate, CPA und ROAS, leitest daraus ab, was als Nächstes getestet wird, und multiplizierst, was gewinnt.

- Du arbeitest im Testplan der Agentur, bekommst ihre Learnings und lieferst, was sie zum Skalieren braucht.

- Du arbeitest mit dem Material, das da ist: Brand-Shootings, Bewegtbild aus dem Creative Department, Creator- und UGC-Content. Du zeigst, wo Shootings oder weitere Produktionen nötig sind. Templates und AI-Workflows sorgen für Tempo.

- Du bleibst am Puls: welche Formate im E-Commerce gerade performen, was die besten D2C-Brands machen. Dieses Wissen bringst du ins Team.

Was du mitbringst

- Zwei bis vier Jahre Erfahrung im Bau von Performance-Ads im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld, in einer Agentur, einer Brand oder als Freelancer.

- Ein Portfolio mit echten Ads, die live waren. Du kannst erklären, warum sie funktioniert haben oder nicht.

- Du denkst in Hooks, den ersten drei Sekunden und Varianten, nicht in Einzelstücken.

- Sicher in Figma oder Adobe für Statics und in CapCut, Premiere oder After Effects für Video. AI-Tools gehören zu deinem Alltag.

- Du kennst Meta und TikTok von innen: Formate, Specs, was im Feed funktioniert und warum beide Plattformen unterschiedlich ticken.

- Du arbeitest gern in einem System, bist schnell und hast trotzdem ein Auge für Marke. Du sagst uns, wenn eine Ad performt, aber nicht nach Qstar aussieht.

- Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Nutrition oder Supplements und ein Gefühl dafür, was bei Health Claims geht und was nicht. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei.

Deutsch fließend (mindestens C1). Du arbeitest hybrid in Hamburg.

Was wir bieten

Eine Rolle, die es bei uns noch nicht gibt und die du von Anfang an prägst, mit einem Launch Anfang 2027 und einem Sortiment, das wächst. Du siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit in Zahlen bewegt. Direkter Draht zu Growth, Creative Direction und den Gründern. Budget für Tools. Ein Büro in Hamburg, das wir gerade zum Content-Studio ausbauen. Hybrides Arbeiten. 48.000 bis 58.000 € brutto im Jahr, je nach Erfahrung. Und Produkte, die du selbst nutzen willst.

So läuft es

Ein erstes Gespräch mit Growth und Creative. Därt führst du uns durch dein Portfolio. Im zweiten Schritt stellst du uns vor, wie du ein Ad-System für Qstar aufbauen würdest. Diesen Case vergüten wir. Dann Kennenlernen im Team. Von der Bewerbung bis zur Entscheidung maximal drei Wochen.

Schick uns dein Portfolio mit Ads, die live waren, deinen Lebenslauf und drei Sätze zu einer Frage: Welche Ad aus deinem Feed hat dich zuletzt zum Kauf gebracht, und warum? Bewerbungen ohne Portfolio können wir nicht berücksichtigen.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

- Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.

- Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.

- Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.

- Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.

- Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.

- Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.

- Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.

- Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

What we are looking for

- Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.

- Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.

- Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.

- Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.

- Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.

- Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.

- Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.

- Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

Useful experience, but not required

- DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.

- Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.

- GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.

- Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.

- Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.

- Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.

What we offer you

At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.

- Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.

- Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.

- Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working.

- Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.

- A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office.

About Smartly

Smartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally.

We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.

Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Direct experience with every technology listed here is less important than the judgment to learn, reason from first principles, and ship useful platform capabilities.

About Smartly 

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.

Visit Smartly to learn more.

Dein Profil - Mehrjährige Erfahrung als SAP SD Consultant, SAP Sales Consultant oder SAP Key User mit fundiertem Verständnis von Vertriebsprozessen.

title: Mobile Engineer - ElevenMusic
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and share. The team is small, agent-first and sits apart from the main org, with very fast CI, so ideas often ship the same or next day. Today, one engineer runs the whole iOS app alone.

We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer to own ElevenMusic across iOS and Android, and to make mobile a driver of the product rather than a downstream port of web features. You’ll build for musicians and creatives, think in systems as well as screens, and work with high autonomy and a high bar for taste.

Requirements 

- Shipped a well-designed, production mobile app that real users love, and can show us what you owned.

- Strong systems thinking across mobile and backend. We’re framework-agnostic (React Native, Swift or Kotlin), but expect you to work across iOS and Android.

- Exceptional product taste and a clear view on what makes a mobile experience great.

- Highly self-directed: you turn loose directions into shipped work and own the outcome.

Bonus: musical interest or intuition. Open-source or GitHub contributions.

Location 

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Warsaw, and Amsterdam.

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company with a diversified portfolio of lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. About the role 

We are looking for a technically strong, proactive and detail-oriented Senior Product Integrity Engineer to join our UK team, with a focus on design assurance, engineering validation and product quality.

Embedded within the New Product Development (NPD) process, you will take ownership of product integrity activities from concept through to production launch, ensuring quality, safety, reliability and consumer expectations are built into the design.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Industrial Design, Product Development, Manufacturing and Supply Chain to lead risk assessment and validation activities. You will use engineering judgement, test evidence and consumer insights to challenge designs, resolve risks and influence decisions at critical development milestones.

This role offers broad cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to directly influence whether our products deliver SharkNinja’s 5-star quality standard.

Key responsibilities 

Design assurance and engineering validation 

- 
Lead product integrity input into design reviews, Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), design verification and validation planning (DVP&R), and safety reviews throughout the NPD lifecycle.

- 
Own the development and delivery of risk-based verification and validation plans, establishing clear test methods, acceptance criteria and evidence requirements aligned with product specifications and applicable UK, European and other target-market requirements.

- 
Challenge design assumptions and assess product performance, reliability, robustness and foreseeable use conditions, ensuring risks are understood and addressed before tooling and production release.

- 
Evaluate engineering changes for their impact on quality, safety and performance, defining appropriate revalidation requirements to prevent regression.

- 
Review and approve quality-related manufacturing and test documentation within your remit, ensuring requirements are clearly translated into production controls.

- 
Contribute to Design for Manufacture (DFM) reviews, assessing tolerances, process capability and potential sources of manufacturing variation.

- 
Provide evidence-based recommendations on product readiness, escalating unresolved risks and driving corrective action ahead of development milestones.

Cross-functional leadership and quality governance 

- 
Represent product integrity within cross-functional NPD teams, translating consumer expectations and quality requirements into practical engineering decisions.

- 
Lead quality risk and action reviews, establishing clear ownership, priorities and closure criteria.

- 
Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain and suppliers to define process controls, quality gates and production acceptance criteria ahead of mass production.

- 
Lead technical investigation of issues identified during prototype, pilot and pre-production builds, coordinating root-cause analysis and verifying corrective action effectiveness.

- 
Challenge supplier 8D investigations and corrective action proposals, ensuring conclusions are supported by robust evidence.

- 
Drive corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities addressing design and process gaps, tracking actions through to verified closure.

- 
Provide technical guidance to colleagues and support the development of consistent product integrity practices across programmes.

Data analysis and continuous improvement 

- 
Analyse validation results, build data, test failures and relevant field performance insights to identify emerging risks and prioritise improvements.

- 
Define and monitor quality metrics, validation coverage and acceptance criteria throughout the development cycle.

- 
Apply lessons from existing products to new designs, strengthening test coverage and preventing repeat failures.

- 
Improve validation methods and pre-production quality processes, addressing systemic gaps with sustainable solutions.

- 
Communicate validation status, residual risks and corrective action progress clearly to senior management and cross-functional stakeholders.

Skills and experience 

Essential 

- 
A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Quality Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

- 
Substantial relevant engineering experience, typically gained over five or more years, with demonstrated ownership of design verification, validation or product integrity activities.

- 
Practical experience leading DFMEA, DVP&R, technical design reviews and engineering change assessments.

- 
A strong understanding of product development lifecycles, design and document control, and verification and validation methodologies.

- 
Experience translating product requirements and engineering risks into measurable test plans and acceptance criteria.

- 
Strong technical problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to interpret test data and assess corrective action effectiveness.

- 
Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams, challenge technical decisions constructively and drive issues through to resolution.

- 
Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and recommendations to engineering teams and senior stakeholders.

- 
Confidence managing multiple programmes and competing priorities in a fast-paced development environment.

- 
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint, with experience using data to support engineering decisions.

- 
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams, regions and supplier partners.

Desirable 

- 
Experience developing consumer appliances, electromechanical products or other high-volume consumer goods.

- 
Experience working within rapid NPD cycles and supporting products through tooling, pilot builds and production launch.

- 
Knowledge of reliability engineering, accelerated life testing, statistical analysis or Design of Experiments (DOE).

- 
Familiarity with supplier quality processes, Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), process capability assessment and incoming quality controls.

- 
Understanding of applicable product safety standards and UK and European product compliance requirements.

- 
Experience incorporating human factors, usability and foreseeable misuse into product validation.

- 
Experience working with international manufacturing partners and suppliers.

Travel 

The role may require travel within the UK and internationally to support development builds, manufacturing sites and supplier activities.

Our Culture 

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day. Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test | Luma
description:
Our Why At Dotmatics 

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research. 

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics 

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. 

What do we need 

We are seeking an SDET to join one of our agile engineering teams and help us build quality into LUMA, our scientific software platform. You'll take ownership of testing for a specific module of the application — writing and maintaining automated tests, exploring new features, and working alongside developers, application scientists and DevOps engineers to make sure what we ship is reliable.

This is a hands-on automation role with room to grow. You'll be contributing to established test frameworks rather than building them from scratch, with support from senior SDETs who will help you develop your technical depth and your understanding of the science behind the product.

While the primary focus is automation, the role also involves manual exploratory testing.

In this role you will get to: 

- Write, maintain and extend automated test suites for your module using Cucumber, TypeScript and Cypress (and Playwright where we use it).

- Own day-to-day quality for your area: contributing test scenarios during planning, testing stories as they're built, and giving the team a clear picture of release readiness.

- Design and document test cases that cover functional, regression and integration scenarios, and keep them useful as the product evolves.

- Investigate and reproduce defects, raise well-evidenced bug reports in JIRA, and verify fixes with developers and scientists.

- Keep your tests green and trustworthy in our CI pipelines, and help improve how tests run and report.

- Learn to read and interpret API documentation and turn it into meaningful automated coverage.

- Work with leading experts in software development, scientific product management and test automation — and be mentored by them.

Who we're looking for: 

You'll have 2–5 years' experience in QA/testing, including at least a year of hands-on test automation . You're comfortable working in a code-first way, you enjoy digging into how things work, and you're happy asking questions when a domain is unfamiliar. You work carefully and pay attention to detail, and you can take a story or module, understand it and devise a concrete approach to testing going above and beyond the standard acceptance criteria.

Just as importantly, you want to get better. We're looking for someone who takes feedback well, is curious about the scientific problems our users are solving and wants to grow into a senior automation engineer over time.

The Key Skills we are looking for: 

- Practical experience with Cypress — writing tests, using selectors and custom commands, debugging failures, and working within an existing Page Object Model. Experience testing React applications is a plus.

- Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript , including asynchronous code (promises, async/await). You don't need to be an expert in generics and interfaces, but you should be able to read and write clean, maintainable test code.

- Experience with BDD / Cucumber , or a willingness to pick it up quickly — we write most of our specs in Gherkin.

- Test case design and documentation — the ability to break a feature down into clear, repeatable scenarios and write them up so others can follow them.

- Comfort with Git and GitHub , including branching, pull requests and code review, plus experience working in JIRA or a similar tracking system.

You may also have: 

- Experience with Playwright, or interest in learning it — we use it for a subset of our tests.

- Exposure to API testing tools (Postman, REST clients) or writing API-level automated tests.

- Any experience with performance or load testing (K6 or similar).

- Familiarity with validating data integrity across release upgrades, migrations or schema changes.

- A background or interest in science, engineering or research software.

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information. 

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
The climate crisis is the defining challenge of our time—but it’s also the greatest opportunity for innovation, and a challenge we’re proud to take on. At Overstory, we’re harnessing cutting-edge technology to enable a resilient electrical grid that keeps communities thriving as our world changes.

The grid is the backbone of life as we know it. It powers hospitals, keeps food fresh, and ensures communities stay connected. But extreme weather, aging infrastructure, and growing wildfire risks are putting this critical system under pressure. All of this combined makes the electric utility industry the greatest opportunity for tackling climate change. 

One of the leading causes of catastrophic wildfires and power outages? Trees and brush coming into contact with power lines. 

That’s where we help. At Overstory, we use AI and advanced satellite imagery to pinpoint and prioritize vegetation risks before they materialize. By giving utilities critical analysis on those risks, we’re helping prevent outages, reduce wildfire risks, and accelerate the transition to a safer, more resilient grid.

Our team spans the Americas and Europe, and we work with utility partners across the Americas and beyond. We’re outdoor enthusiasts, musicians, artists, athletes, parents, and adventurers. What unites us is a passion for solving complex problems, a commitment to climate action, and the belief that technology should be a force for good.

Join us to help us build a more resilient world together. 

Role & Team

As a Staff Data Engineer at Overstory, you will lead the design and scaling of the data platform that enables Overstory’s AI-powered vegetation analysis. Our analysis depends on moving enormous volumes of satellite imagery, model inferences, and utility network data through orchestrated pipelines reliably, repeatably, and on time to support customer decision-making. You'll own the architecture of that platform and set the direction for how it evolves.

You'll work closely with data, ML, and product engineers, as well as product teams, to make sure the data flowing into our models and out to our customers balances pragmatic delivery with durability, traceability, and scalability. As a senior technical leader, you'll mentor other engineers, drive architectural decisions, and set standards for pipeline design, service boundaries, and data quality across Overstory.

Time zone requirement: Europe (GMT/WET, CET, EET) and Eastern North America (NST, AST, EST)

What You'll Do 

In collaboration with data, ML, and product colleagues, you will:

- Architect and evolve our orchestration layer — asset graphs, quality checks, partitioning strategies, and the patterns that keep it scaling reliably.

- Design and maintain production data pipelines for large-scale geospatial and temporal data, from ingestion through transformation to delivery.

- Lead system design work across the data platform, including service boundaries, data contracts, and designing around the failure modes that come with each.

- Drive the shift toward a service-oriented architecture, decoupling tightly bound components into services that teams can own and deploy independently.

- Build event-driven workflows, replacing brittle coupling and manual coordination with durable messaging patterns.

- Establish observability, testing, and data quality frameworks so problems surface before customers see them, allowing any result to be traced back and explained.

- Mentor engineers and define the standards for how we build, test, and operate data systems.

Skills & Experience 

- Experience thriving at the intersection of data engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale scientific data; deeply motivated by the opportunity to reduce wildfire risk and improve grid resilience through better data patterns and infrastructure

- 10+ years of experience designing and building production-grade data pipelines and systems

- Deep hands-on experience with Dagster — asset-based orchestration, partitions, sensors, and the operational side of running it in production (comparable experience with Airflow, Prefect, or similar is a reasonable substitute if you're ready to go deep on Dagster)

- Proven track record building and operating data pipelines at scale, with a real feel for idempotency, backfills, and partitioning

- Experience in preparing systems to handle periods of high demand with a focus on testability and scalability best practices

- Strong system design skills — you can reason about boundaries, contracts, coupling, and failure modes, and explain the tradeoffs to people who'll use and build on them

- Practical experience designing service-oriented architecture , including versioning and keeping things operational through migrations

- Strong Python skills and experience with Google Cloud 

- Experience with Pub/Sub and event-driven patterns

- Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, ML, and product

- Comfortable leading architectural discussions and mentoring other engineers

- Experience in remote-first and globally distributed team

Nice To Have 

- Comfort working with geospatial data and the ways that it’s stored

- Experience building data pipelines that power ML training and inference

- Experience with analytics engineering tooling and warehouse modeling in BigQuery

- Infrastructure-as-code experience and comfort owning your systems in production

- Background in remote sensing, forestry, or the utility sector

Note: We believe that all people are capable of great things. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description. 

What We Offer 

- Competitive, location-specific compensation and benefits 

- Flexible, autonomous and collaborative working environment rooted in trust - we build our work days around our lives, not the other way around

- Home office stipend, coworking and ongoing education budgets 

- A company culture that genuinely embodies each of our core values

- To be part of truly mission-driven work that reduces wildfires, protects earth’s natural resources and helps solve our climate crisis

About Our Team 

We are a fast-growing team of about 100 people from all over the world. Fifteen nationalities are represented and at last count we speak fourteen languages: English, Dutch, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Luxembourgish, Lithuanian, Bulgarian, Finnish, Estonian, and Afrikaans.

We work remotely from eleven countries and are looking for candidates that are living and working in one of them: United States, the Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Estonia, Portugal, France, Sweden, Switzerland, Denmark and Canada. We gather once a year in-person for our unforgettable team gathering event. We also offer the option to occasionally meet up for in-person collaboration. 

Diversity & Inclusion 

The climate crisis is a human crisis that requires diverse perspectives to solve. 

We place enormous value on diversity and believe that the best ideas emerge when people with different backgrounds and experience work together. We remain committed to scaling a team that reflects the communities we serve, and strive to uphold equitable and inclusive practices across every aspect of our business. We are responsible for creating and maintaining a culture where everyone - regardless of background - has a voice in building a sustainable future.

Our Values 

Tackling the climate crisis is our greatest mission. 

We act with urgency.

Our curiosity fuels our growth. 

We recognize that change is constant, and we find joy and power in exploration.

We’re rooted in diversity. 

Just as ecosystems need biodiversity to thrive, our resiliency comes from our differences.

We care for each other. 

We love the power of machines but we nurture each other as humans.

Trust is fundamental. 

We assume the best in everyone, and we share ideas openly so that we have a positive impact.

- Perform accurate case labelling to support AI model training, evaluation pipelines, and ongoing quality benchmarking, demonstrating Excellence through careful and consistent application of established guidance.

- Review and maintain golden sets that reflect current policy standards and provide reliable ground truth for assessing AI quality, accuracy, and precision.

- Report quality issues through established workflows, taking ownership of accurate categorisation, clear documentation, and actionable feedback, and seeing insights through to meaningful impact.

- Collaborate purposefully with the AI Performance & Enablement Manager on scoring consistency, calibration, recurring quality issues, and opportunities to strengthen AI reliability and the member experience.

- Identify patterns and share learnings that can improve AI accuracy and precision, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency, approaching emerging challenges with Curiosity and an agile mindset.

- Use QA platforms and AI-supported tools, including systems such as Cinder, Zendesk QA, and Bumble’s internal assessment tooling, to monitor quality and understand AI behaviour, reviewing outputs critically for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness and applying human judgment before acting on results.

About you 

- Requires 1+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

- Bring experience or transferable skills from Trust & Safety, content moderation, Customer Experience, quality assurance, or another fast-paced, policy-driven environment.

- Have a sharp eye for detail and can objectively evaluate conversations, moderation decisions, and other interactions against established policies, processes, and quality standards.

- Bring familiarity with conversational AI systems, chatbots, automated moderation, or AI-supported workflows, with the Curiosity to continue learning how these systems behave, where their limitations lie, and how human judgment can improve their effectiveness.

- Understand, or are motivated to learn, quality assurance practices such as case labelling, calibration, consistent scoring, golden-set evaluation, and clear documentation of quality findings.

- Are comfortable learning digital tools and platforms and can use data and quality insights to identify meaningful patterns while adapting your approach as systems, policies, and priorities evolve.

- Collaborate purposefully with colleagues, take ownership of your deliverables, and see work through from insight to impact while welcoming feedback as an opportunity to learn and improve.

- Apply AI thoughtfully and responsibly, assessing outputs for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness rather than relying on them without review, and demonstrate Bumble’s values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and colleagues.

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. title: Senior Product Manager, Software Delivery
description:
