At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.

The Role 

As Senior Product Manager, Software Delivery, you will sit at the handoff point between ideas and engineering — taking a raw idea or ask and shaping it into a well-formed request the software team can build against. You own the what: defining the problem, scope, and acceptance criteria behind every request. Working alongside the Project Manager, who runs sprints and day-to-day delivery mechanics, you'll advocate for how requests should be sequenced and when they should land, making sure priority calls reflect the needs behind the work rather than just what's next in the queue.

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day. 

Responsibilities: 

- Turn ideas into formal requests: work with the Product Lead and other stakeholders to take a defined ask and translate it into a clear, engineering-ready ticket — problem statement, scope, acceptance criteria, and any relevant regulatory or clinical context — before it enters the backlog.

- Own and prioritise the software ticket pipeline in Jira: intake, triage, and grooming, so the backlog reflects real, current priority rather than the order things happened to arrive in.

- Own the idea-to-documentation handoff with the software team — making sure every piece of work that reaches engineering has the context, requirements, and supporting documentation it needs in Confluence, and that decisions made along the way are captured rather than lost in Slack.

- Advocate for how and when work should happen: partner with the Project Manager, who owns sprint planning and delivery mechanics, to make sure sequencing and timing reflect genuine priority rather than convenience.

- Keep the software pipeline's information in the right place — Jira for delivery, Confluence for documentation — rather than in slide decks or side channels, and help extend that operating model as the team grows.

Skills & Experience: 

- Experience as a Product Manager, Technical Product Manager, or Product Owner working directly with a software engineering team, ideally in a regulated or safety-conscious environment.

- Comfort writing requirements and acceptance criteria precise enough for engineers to build against without repeated back-and-forth.

- A natural translator: equally comfortable in a conversation with a non-technical stakeholder describing a problem and in a ticket-grooming session with engineers debating implementation trade-offs.

- Comfortable in an early-stage environment where requests arrive informally and priorities shift, and where part of the job is imposing structure rather than just following it.

- Drawn to the operational side of product management — energised by getting the machinery of idea-to-delivery running smoothly, not just by defining the vision.

- Nice to have: experience in medical devices or another regulated hardware/software environment, with exposure to documentation practices under ISO 13485 or IEC 62304.

- Nice to have: prior experience setting up or overhauling a ticket intake and triage process from scratch, rather than inheriting one.

- Nice to have: some exposure to embedded or real-time software, enough to sanity-check scope and complexity when shaping requests.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Our teams move quickly, focus on outcomes, and take ownership from concept through to delivery. We solve complex problems, modernise processes, and enable the business to scale with confidence.

The Staff Full Stack Engineer is responsible for setting technical direction across multiple squads, typically overseeing 2–3 squads and line-managing 3–5 Full Stack Engineers. The role exists to shape architecture, ensure the success of these squads, and drive consistent, secure, and compliant delivery across Allica’s digital products.

You will use your expertise in Spring Boot microservices (Java/Kotlin) and modern web technologies (React/TypeScript) to define and evolve cross-squad patterns, shared tooling, and platform capabilities.

Our backend microservices are containerised and deployed to Azure Container Apps, and our web applications are deployed to Azure Static Web Apps; you will help define and uphold the standards that make these platforms robust, cost-effective, and easy to operate.

You will own key cross-cutting concerns such as authentication, observability, performance, accessibility, and regulatory compliance, ensuring our systems meet the standards expected of a UK bank.

You are hands-on: you design and review architectures, pair with engineers, and contribute code to high-impact initiatives.

You work closely with Product, Design and other engineering leaders to align technical direction with business goals and to unblock delivery.

You drive the responsible adoption of GenAI and agentic engineering practices (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot), setting organisation-wide standards and measuring impact.

Success in this role is reflected in simpler architectures, improved delivery consistency and reliability, stronger engineering effectiveness, and the growth and performance of your direct reports and squads.

- Backend services (Kotlin/Java Spring Boot microservices, REST/OpenAPI, messaging, integrations).

- Frontend architectures (React/TypeScript, shared design system, Nx, micro frontends where appropriate).

- Establish and improve SLOs, error budget policies, and incident management practices across key services; lead post-incident reviews and drive follow-through on structural fixes.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, UKI
description:
About Telnyx 

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications. 

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team. 

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers. 

The Role 

We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in London — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless.

This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale.

You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.

The Pod Model 

Enterprise AE — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account. 

Forward Deployed Engineer — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.

We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.

What You'll Do 

• Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand
• Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC
• Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it
• Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys
• Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing
• Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't
• Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades
• Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both
• Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for English-language use cases and UK/Irish-specific regulatory environments (UK GDPR, Data Protection Act 2018, EU AI Act for cross-border workloads)
• Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live
• Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable
• Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on field insights from the UK and Ireland
• Create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and maintainable solutions for handoff

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues alongside customer teams

What We're Looking For 

• CS degree or equivalent experience
• 3+ years building and shipping production software — you've written code that real users depended on, you've been on-call for it, and you've debugged it when things broke. (A consulting background counts if this is also true of you.)
• Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.)
• Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency
• Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story
• You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You know what to monitor, what to alert on, and what "healthy" looks like
• High-concurrency experience — Kafka, message queues, or event streams at real scale. When throughput spikes you know what breaks — consumer lag, backpressure, hot partitions, rebalance stalls — and what absorbs it: partitioning, consumer groups, parallelism up to your partition count
• You've built APIs from scratch, not just consumed them — OpenAPI spec, REST/GraphQL design, auth, rate limiting, versioning, idempotency

title: Care Account Manager (Clinical), Europe & West Africa
description:
The Role 

Intellect delivers a clinically governed mental health programme to enterprise clients in the mining and resources sector, supporting remote and expatriate workforces. This is not a standard EAP. Cases begin with acute risk assessment on remote sites and run through structured treatment, fitness-for-work assessment and return-to-work clearance, in direct coordination with the client's chaplaincy, medical and people teams.

This role covers the client's United Kingdom operations and a West African project site where the working language is French. It is a combined clinical delivery and case management role: the postholder conducts the assessments, delivers the therapy, writes the reports and owns the case, rather than coordinating a provider network. That design reflects the absence of an established provider network in the West African market at launch, and gives the client a single clinician who knows each case end to end.

Full professional fluency in French and English is a non-negotiable requirement. Welfare calls, clinical assessment, case documentation and client communication in the West African market are conducted in French.

Responsibilities

Clinical assessment and delivery 

- Conduct acute risk and welfare assessments for employees referred through the client's escalation pathway, in French or English as required.
- Deliver individual counselling and psychotherapy across the supported caseload, virtually.
- Conduct fitness-for-work assessments and produce the associated clinical documentation.
- Write risk assessments, session documentation, return-to-work memoranda and fitness-for-work reports to a standard that stands up to client and regulatory scrutiny, in the language the case requires.
- Delivery is capped so that case management availability is protected. Session load is agreed with the Head of Clinical Operations and reviewed as volume changes.
Case management and coordination 

- Own each case end to end, from referral through assessment, treatment, fitness-for-work and reintegration to closure.
- Align the initial support plan with the client's on-site teams, including session volume and cadence, and manage adjustments where clinically indicated.
- Coordinate with internal helpline, care excellence and network partnership teams on anything that cannot be delivered directly.
- Review the open case list for stalled items and follow up to keep cases moving.
Clinical risk oversight and governance 

- Confirm risk tiering against the client's framework and set review cadence and monitoring requirements.
- Make the clinical decisions the pathway requires, including disputed risk ratings and medical evaluation pathways where an employee declines therapy.
- Escalate to the Head of Clinical Operations where a case exceeds the scope of remote delivery or requires in-person intervention.
- Work within the differing regulatory, medical and emergency-escalation environments of each market, and flag where local pathways do not support the agreed protocol.
Clinical protocols and client enablement 

- Co-develop and maintain the clinical protocols, risk frameworks and SOPs the client's on-site teams operate to, including French-language versions.
- Design and deliver clinical training and framework guidance to client-side staff who are not clinicians, in French and English.
- Build out the in-market provider network alongside Network Partnerships, so that in-person and overflow capacity exists as the programme scales.
Client relationship, insights and reporting 

- Act as the named clinical contact for the client's chaplaincy, medical and health and safety leads in both markets, responding within the core window to queries that are frequently unscheduled and time-critical.
- Produce the case tracker and monthly clinical reporting, moving beyond utilisation to presenting issues, risk patterns, outcomes and service-level themes.
- Present clinical insight at client review meetings and translate it into recommendations the client's health and safety and people teams can act on.
Requirements 

- Full professional fluency in French and English, to the standard required for clinical assessment, therapy delivery and client-facing documentation in both languages.
- Registered clinical psychologist or qualified counsellor, with current registration in your jurisdiction and the right to practise remotely.
- Master's degree in clinical psychology, counselling or a related field.
- Minimum three years in clinical practice, including direct delivery of assessment and therapy to adults.
- Demonstrable experience managing acute risk, including suicidality, in a setting where you held the decision rather than advised on it.
- Experience of structured return-to-work, fitness-for-work or occupational mental health pathways.
- Able to work four hours a day, Monday to Friday, within the 08:00 to 17:00 UK and West Africa window.
Desirable 

- Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or with expatriate, rotational or multinational workforces.
- Understanding of remote industrial, mining, resources or energy operating environments.
- Additional language capability, particularly Mandarin.
- Experience contributing to clinical protocols, risk frameworks or SOPs.
- Prior case management or clinical account experience in a commercial setting.

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes : 

Rattachement hiérarchique 

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

Mission principale 

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES 

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température 

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

Étude et déploiement des matériels 

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation 

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

Gestion des fournisseurs 

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

Qualité et amélioration continue 

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES 

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à : 

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES 

En interne 

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe 

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

PROFIL RECHERCHE 

Formation 

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience 

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques 

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles 

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste 

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

• Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température.

• Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport.

• Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié

title: Solutions Engineer - French Speaker
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

We’re hiring Solutions Engineers to build Synthesia’s presales function in France and Southern EMEA. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. If you’re someone who is excited by building whilst scaling, we’d love to hear from you.

As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product.

This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across France and Southern EMEA.

Sales Cycle Ownership & AE Partnership 

- Co-plan and support discovery calls with your AE to understand customer requirements, technical environment, and business challenges.

- Deliver demonstrations that speak to customer problems and tell a credible story of why Synthesia is the right solution.

- Identify technical objections and integration questions as they come up, working with your AE and the broader ecosystem to find a path forward.

- Contribute your assessment of technical fit and opportunity risk to help your AE shape account and deal strategy.

- Keep your deal team and manager informed on deal status, timeline, and technical dependencies.

Demo Excellence 

- Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia's business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.

- Identify, build relationships with, and actively enable technical champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally.

- Develop and maintain reusable assets across demo environments, use cases, integration templates, objection handling, and industry playbooks, brought to life directly in Synthesia's platform.

- Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments, troubleshooting issues and validating integrations with LMS, HCM, and content systems as they surface.

Product Expertise 

- Build and maintain strong working knowledge of Synthesia's platform capabilities, roadmap, and positioning across all product lines, so you can speak to the use cases that drive value.

- Partner with Enablement to complete certifications, stay current on new releases, and keep your demo and objection-handling skills sharp.

- Stay ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development.

Ecosystem Collaboration 

- Product: share customer and prospect feedback with Product, flagging pain points, missing capabilities, and gaps that surface in your deals to help shape the roadmap.

- Product Marketing: work with Product Marketing to understand and apply messaging and positioning in your deal cycles, and contribute to reusable assets like demo scripts and competitive battlecards.

- Customer Success: brief Customer Success on technical context and champion relationships at handover, so your POCs and pilots convert cleanly into production deployments.

What We're Looking For 

- 2+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience in a SaaS environment (or equivalent technical customer-facing experience).

- Delivers a strong standard demo aligned to the discovery points and agenda set with the AE, with a solid grasp of core demo technique (e.g., Tell-Show-Tell).

description:

The role

Nebius Token Factory is looking for scientists who can turn frontier LLM and VLM inference bottlenecks into research questions, conduct rigorous experiments, and translate their findings into production capabilities. You will own focused research and optimization projects, write strong code, and produce prototypes, publications, and technical artifacts that engineers can build on.

Your research will span quantization, distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, and model/runtime co-optimization, alongside inference engines and distributed inference architectures. You will investigate how these approaches interact, evaluate their trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost per token, and work with engineering teams to bring promising results into production.

Your responsibilities

- Lead research projects in efficient LLM and VLM inference, from hypotheses and experiments through ablations, prototypes, and production handoff.

- Develop and evaluate methods spanning quantization, quantization-aware training (QAT), distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, KV-cache compression, long-context inference, MoE routing, and model/runtime co-optimization.

- Build prototypes using PyTorch, Triton, CUDA-adjacent tooling, or inference-serving frameworks, and collaborate with MLEs and platform engineers to turn them into production components.

- Research LLM request routing and scheduling strategies, including cache-aware load balancing and prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD). Evaluate how queueing, KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and prefill/decode capacity allocation affect latency, throughput, and serving cost.

- Investigate multi-node inference for dense and mixture-of-experts models, including wide expert parallelism (WideEP). Study expert placement, load imbalance, and computation/communication trade-offs, and use the findings to guide model and system architecture choices.

- Develop rigorous evaluations covering quality, latency, throughput, numerical stability, memory footprint, tail latency, and cost per token. Compare serving architectures under consistent workload conditions and GPU budgets.

- Work with MLE, GPU kernel, backend infrastructure, product, and customer teams to select research priorities with measurable production impact.

- Share results through internal reports, technical blogs, papers, and open-source artifacts, and mentor engineers and scientists on experimental design, scientific rigor, and model/system trade-offs.

Must-haves

- A PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, or a closely related discipline.

- A strong publication record or equivalent research artifacts in ML, ML systems, efficient inference, model compression, quantization, distillation, serving systems, or related areas.

- Strong Python and PyTorch implementation skills, with the ability to turn ideas into experiments and working prototypes.

- Deep knowledge of LLMs, VLMs, transformer inference, decoding algorithms, model compression, quantization, and production-serving trade-offs.

- Strong experimental design skills covering ablations, baselines, metrics, statistical reasoning, and failure analysis.

- Excellent written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-haves

- First-author publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, ACL, EMNLP, ASPLOS, OSDI, SOSP, ISCA, or HPCA.

- Experience deploying ML models or inference optimizations in production.

- Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Triton, CUDA, or PyTorch internals.

- Experience applying post-training, SFT, DPO, RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or synthetic data generation to inference quality or efficiency.

title: Staff Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. 

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.
Travel: 
Job ID: 1917 

The Role: 

We are looking for a Staff QA Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will own product-level quality assurance: the system test plans, automation and compliance test execution that stand between an engineering release and a product customers can trust. In a security product, QA is not an afterthought; it is part of the evidence.

Responsibilities :

You will define and execute system-level test plans for FPGA-based cryptographic products: functional, performance, stress, stability and negative testing across the full stack, from hardware through firmware and drivers to cryptographic APIs. You will build and maintain the automated QA infrastructure (regression suites, hardware-in-the-loop test benches, CI integration, results dashboards), execute standards-based compliance test campaigns (NIST ACVP/CAVP test vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence runs, CNSA 2.0 checklists and standard FPGA compliance tests) together with our verification and security engineers, run interoperability testing against protocol stacks and customer-representative configurations, own defect tracking and triage, and define the release-qualification criteria for every product release.

- Own system-level QA of cryptographic hardware products: test plans, automation, execution and release qualification

- Execute standards and compliance test campaigns (ACVP/CAVP vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence, CNSA 2.0 and FPGA compliance tests) as part of the certification effort

Requirements: 

We are looking for a candidate with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience) and at least five years in quality assurance or system test of embedded, hardware or networking products. You have built test automation in Python or similar, integrated it into CI, and worked hands-on with lab equipment and hardware-in-the-loop setups.

Exposure to security or compliance testing (FIPS, Common Criteria, or telecom/industrial certification regimes) is a strong plus, as is experience testing cryptographic or networking functionality. You are rigorous, methodical and precise in documentation, because in this product your test reports become certification evidence. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

- Experienced system-test/QA engineer for embedded or hardware products with strong automation skills

- Compliance or security test experience and meticulous documentation habits are strong advantages

Preferred Qualifications: 

You take professional pride in being the last line of defence before a release, you like breaking things methodically so customers never do, and you enjoy the extra weight QA carries when the product is a security device.

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. 

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.

We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

US Technical Jobs. The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions. Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls. Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.

title: Account Executive, Enterprise
Quality Platform Lead
description:
At Vio we believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust.

Who we're looking for

We are looking for a hands-on Quality Platform Lead to own Vio's quality strategy and automation platform across web, mobile, browser extensions, internal tooling and related surfaces.

This is a technical leadership role (Staff IC) reporting to the Director of Engineering. You define what good looks like for quality, decide where scarce testing effort goes, and give teams the confidence to ship. Your levers are release gates, quality telemetry, and a developer experience that makes the right tests easy to write and keep alive.

Product engineers own the tests for the features they build. Your remit is the platform, the strategy and the enablement that make that work hold up at scale. There is no QA department here and we have no plans to create one.

Where you'll start

- Web: Playwright, Checkly, BrowserStack

- Mobile: Patrol (Flutter)

- Coverage gaps across white-labels, browser extensions, widgets, APIs and internal tooling

- Web: Playwright, Checkly, BrowserStack

- Mobile: Patrol (Flutter)

- Coverage gaps across white-labels, browser extensions, widgets, APIs and internal tooling

The tooling can stay as it is. With a clear case you can migrate or rebuild. E2E coverage today is thin, so a different platform is genuinely on the table if it serves speed, maintainability and DX better. We have no predefined answer.

AI-assisted tooling is an open area too. We have no established practice for agent-generated tests or AI-assisted triage, so your judgment on what earns a place in the platform carries real weight.

What we lack today is clear ownership of strategy, release gates and shared quality telemetry, plus a low-friction path for engineers to spend their testing effort on the highest-risk scenarios.

How the role works

Your time splits between hands-on platform work, enablement, strategy and stakeholder telemetry. One insourced QA Engineer supports you. You own the technical direction, the standards and the quality outcomes.

Once the platform has low friction, product engineers write and maintain the tests for the domains they own. You enable that through patterns, docs, reusable modules, CI checks and risk-based guidance. Gatekeeping releases sits outside the role.

Expect no direct people-management responsibilities in the near future. Any further QE hire gets evaluated against the ~1:50 rule once the value is proven, and we have no committed headcount plan beyond that.

What you'll own

Quality strategy and platform

- Own the quality strategy and the automation platform across products, covering direction, standards and day-to-day health

- Decide whether to keep, evolve or replace the current tooling, with clear trade-offs on speed, maintainability and DX

- Set coding standards and patterns for test code, and keep the suite focused on the tests that earn their place

Release gates and telemetry

- Build automated release gates into CI/CD and define what protects the core journeys

- Give Product, Engineering and leadership real-time quality telemetry on release readiness, risk and pipeline health

- Put failure triage and flaky-test quarantine in place, so every failure is worth acting on

Risk-based coverage and testability

- Work with Product and Engineering to protect high-impact journeys and APIs

- Retire flaky and low-value tests, and concentrate effort where the risk is highest

- Act as the technical stakeholder for testability (hooks, mocks, contract tests, test data) and get those improvements onto team roadmaps

Developer enablement

- Make it easy for product engineers to write, run and maintain tests locally and in CI

- Embed quality into how teams plan and ship, and mentor the insourced QA Engineer

- Drive a measurable increase in developer satisfaction with quality tooling and DX

What success looks like in 12 months

- Platform ownership. You have taken over the automation platform across products and own it outright, with direction, standards and health all unambiguous, whether you kept the tooling or replaced it.

- Gates and focus. Release gates on the core journeys are fast and deterministic, and testing effort sits on the highest-risk scenarios.

- Dev ownership and satisfaction. Writing and maintaining tests is a routine part of Definition of Done, and developer satisfaction with quality tooling and DX has measurably improved.

- Telemetry. Eng and Product work from live release-readiness and risk dashboards, failures triage cleanly, and flaky tests go into quarantine.

- Less manual drag. Regular releases go out without manual testing, with exploratory testing reserved for major new work.

Who you are 

- You have a track record of building or overhauling automation platforms (SWE / QE / SDET)

- You write production-grade code across app, test and infra repos. Language matters less to us than depth, though our stack today leans on TypeScript/JS, Elixir, Go, Python and Dart.

- You use AI agents effectively in your own engineering workflow and can judge where they belong inside a quality platform, from test generation to failure triage

- You have cross-platform web and mobile automation judgment, and can weigh unified toolchains against separate ones objectively

- You have deep CI/CD and test infrastructure experience: GitHub Actions, device clouds, parallelisation, test data

- You can translate quality risk into telemetry and decisions that Eng, Product and leadership act on

- You are a hands-on builder who wants to code the platform yourself

- You design platforms developers adopt, and you prioritise risk-based coverage

Trade-offs we accept: depth on one platform when the other is learnable, and no travel or booking domain background.

Why join us now? 

- Full ownership of the quality strategy and the automation platform, with a mandate for enablement

- We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of power features and managed to overcome the corona crisis remarkably fast ;

- The mobile applications ( iOS and Android ) we launched in 2023 are already a big success, reaching 5 million installs with great customer reviews, as we are beginning to build Vio as the brand for value-seeking travellers worldwide;

- We are a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives with a commitment and focus on the traveler above all else - and it shows in our industry-leading TrustPilot score ;

- We place huge importance on rewarding our employees for the value they generate by giving Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

Do you want to know if Vio is the right place for you? Find out by reading about the attitude that thrives at Vio.

title: Working Student - Talent Acquisition
description:
En bref 

Vous avez envie de contribuer à la révolution des supermarchés ? Grâce à une approche basée sur les données (data-driven) et un service unique, Picnic se bat pour faire des courses quelque chose de simple, drôle et accessible à tous. En outre, nous travaillons dans la perspective d’un avenir plus durable en utilisant des technologies de pointe et en exploitant une flotte de véhicules de livraison 100 % électriques.

En 2021, Picnic a levé 600 millions d’euros auprès de la Fondation Bill & Melinda Gates afin de se développer en Europe. Après avoir lancé avec succès les opérations en Allemagne et dans le Nord de la France, nous poursuivons maintenant notre expansion en France en nous développant notamment en région parisienne.

Collaboration: tu travailleras en étroite collaboration avec les recruteurs et les équipes internes pour identifier précisément les besoins en recrutement et dénicher les meilleurs talents.

Innovation: tu apporteras des idées nouvelles pour améliorer continuellement nos méthodes de recrutement et renforcer la performance de l'équipe.

- Tu poursuis actuellement des études en commerce, ressources humaines, psychologie ou dans un domaine similaire.

- Tu maîtrises parfaitement l'anglais et le française à l'oral comme à l'écrit. 

- Tu doté(e) d'un fort esprit d'équipe, d'un grand sens de l'organisation et d'une attention particulière aux détails.

- Chez Picnic, nous utilisons Greenhouse comme ATS. C'est un plus si tu le connais déjà ou si tu as envie de l'apprendre !

Avantages Picnic 

Chaque expert a un jour été débutant ! 

Tu auras de nombreuses occasions de te mettre au défi et de t'épanouir, notamment grâce aux sessions Lunch & Learn et à la formation sur mesure en compétences non techniques. Nous proposons également des cours de langue professionnels hebdomadaires gratuits.

Fais la différence 

Tu travailleras dans un environnement stimulant, avec la liberté de mener tes propres projets et de créer un impact direct et visible.

Grâce à nos véhicules entièrement électriques et à notre modèle économique durable, tu contribueras également à rendre le monde meilleur !

Le travail d'équipe nous fait avancer ! 

Avec plus de 80 nationalités réparties dans 3 pays, tu feras partie d'une entreprise diversifiée qui offre de nombreuses occasions de s'investir, qu'il s'agisse de soirées à thème, d'apéritifs entre collègues ou de nos séjours annuels au ski, etc.

Reste en bonne santé 

La santé mentale est importante. En plus de la possibilité de parler avec des collègues qui agissent en tant que conseiller(ère)s confidentiel(le)s, notre collaboration avec OpenUp te donne un accès facile et gratuit à des psychologues professionnels, ainsi qu'à des ateliers et des outils pratiques.

Il existe de nombreuses communautés et événements sportifs auxquels tu peux participer, du tennis au yoga en passant par l'escalade !

Picnic est un employeur qui respecte l'égalité des chances, ce qui signifie que toutes les décisions concernant les candidatures seront fondées sur les qualifications et le mérite. Chez Picnic, nous célébrons et valorisons nos différences et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail sûr et inclusif où chacun(e) peut être lui(elle)-même.

title: Enterprise Account Executive

About Yenlo 

Yenlo has helped organisations connect their business-critical systems and processes for more than 17 years. We have been a WSO2 Platinum Partner since 2008 and a Boomi partner since 2015, and our customers include Boeing, Hard Rock Café and several ministries and universities. Now we are building on our integration expertise with Data, AI and Automation, so customers can bring their technology into production securely and reliably. What will you do? 

As Enterprise Account Executive, your primary mission is to win new customers and build profitable, long-term business relationships.

- Deliver results. Take ownership of your pipeline, forecasts, new-business targets and the profitability of the deals you win.

We expect you to create opportunities yourself and have the commercial drive to turn them into business.

At Yenlo, you will join an international technology company with around 100 colleagues, strong technical expertise and ambitious plans for the future.

- Real ownership. A new-business role with the freedom to develop opportunities and make a visible commercial impact.

- Attractive earning potential. A competitive fixed salary and a substantial performance-based bonus, with uncapped upside for overachievement.

- A strong technology portfolio. Established capabilities in Integration, API Management, IAM and Managed Services, complemented by growing propositions in Data, AI and Control.

- Access to specialists. Experienced solution architects, consultants and product teams to support discovery, demonstrations, assessments and proposals.

- An international ecosystem. Partnerships with leading technology providers, including Boomi and WSO2, alongside Yenlo's own Connext platform.

- A demonstrable track record of generating your own pipeline and personally closing new enterprise customers.

- Experience selling complex IT services, software, cloud, integration or other enterprise technology solutions.

- Experience managing six-figure deals and longer, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

- Strong outbound prospecting, consultative selling, negotiation and closing skills.

- The ability to engage credibly with senior business and technology decision-makers.

- Enough technical understanding to discuss Integration, APIs, Data and AI, while focusing on business outcomes rather than technical features.

- An entrepreneurial mindset and the resilience to succeed without a fully established sales playbook.

- The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with technical and commercial colleagues.

Experience with platforms such as Boomi, WSO2, MuleSoft, AWS, Azure or related enterprise technologies is an advantage, but not a requirement. An existing network in the Benelux or DACH enterprise market would be a strong plus. We care more about what you have personally achieved than the number of years on your CV or the technology companies you have worked for.

Ready to make an impact? 

If you enjoy opening doors, creating opportunities and winning complex enterprise deals, we would love to meet you.

title: Werkstudent Claims & Legal
description:
Over ons 

Steeds meer mensen in Europa kiezen ervoor om zelfstandig te werken als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Zelfstandig werken biedt vrijheid en flexibiliteit om te bepalen wanneer, hoe en met wie je wilt werken. Het zien groeien van je eigen bedrijf kan zowel professioneel als financieel belonend zijn.

Zelfstandig zijn brengt echter ook onzekerheden met zich mee. De juiste verzekeringen zijn essentieel om voorbereid te zijn op de risico’s van het ondernemerschap.

Bij Insify bieden we transparante, flexibele en eerlijk geprijsde verzekeringen, afgestemd op de behoeften van ondernemers. Zo kunnen zij zich volledig richten op hun werk, in de wetenschap dat ze altijd op ons kunnen rekenen.

Insify verzekert duizenden klanten in heel Europa. Wij bieden betrouwbare verzekeringen zonder ingewikkeld papierwerk. Een verzekering bij Insify sluit je 100% digitaal af, vandaag geregeld is morgen verzekerd.

Hoe wij werken 

Bij Insify hebben we vier kernwaarden: doorzettingsvermogen, impact, zorg en ondernemerschap. Die leggen we kort even uit:

Doorzettingsvermogen : We zijn niet bang voor uitdagingen en gaan juist door waar anderen stoppen.

Impact : We maken het verschil in het leven van onze klanten en belonen hun vertrouwen in ons. 

Zorg : Wij stellen onze klanten altijd centraal. Hun succes is ons doel.

Ondernemerschap : Innovatie zit in ons DNA. We gaan snel en we denken groot. 

Bij Insify word je onderdeel van een hecht team. Daarom werken we het liefst zo veel mogelijk op kantoor. Dat klinkt misschien raar voor een 100% online verzekeraar, maar wij geloven dat een sterke onderlinge band ons helpt sneller te innoveren en onze klanten nog beter te bedienen. Zo’n band is eigenlijk alleen via persoonlijk contact te realiseren.

Door regelmatig naar kantoor te komen, leren nieuwe collega’s bovendien sneller en voelen ze zich eerder thuis.

We begrijpen ook dat je misschien niet elke dag naar kantoor kunt komen of dat er momenten zijn dat je je focus nodig hebt. Daarom is gedeeltelijk thuiswerken in overleg mogelijk.

Operations Team 

Wij zijn degenen die vertrouwen opbouwen bij elk contactmoment—of het nu om een verkoop, een supportgesprek of het afhandelen van een claim gaat. We zorgen ervoor dat prospects en klanten zich gesteund, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelen. Snelheid en kwaliteit zijn voor ons belangrijk, en we volgen onze voortgang nauwgezet zodat we blijven verbeteren. Met het oog op de toekomst bereiden we ons voor op medische acceptatie in 2025—een volgende stap om onze service nóg sterker te maken.

Jouw rol 

Binnen Insify zijn we op zoek naar een ambitieuze werkstudent rechten die op zoek is naar een betekenisvolle bijbaan naast de studie. Een rol waarin juridische kennis direct wordt toegepast, klantcontact centraal staat en waardevolle ervaring wordt opgedaan die uitstekend aansluit bij een toekomstige juridische carrière.

Als werkstudent Claims & Legal Support ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten van Insify met een schade- of arbeidsongeschiktheidsclaim. Je combineert klantgerichtheid met juridische scherpte en zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten snel, eerlijk en zorgvuldig worden geholpen.

Je werkt nauw samen met onze Legal & Claims specialisten en denkt mee over complexe aansprakelijkheidskwesties en bezwaarprocedures. Jij zorgt dat onze belofte van snelle, heldere en menselijke service ook in de praktijk wordt waargemaakt.

Jouw profiel 

- Aanspreekpunt voor klanten. Je helpt klanten die schade melden of arbeidsongeschikt zijn geraakt. Je luistert, stelt de juiste vragen en begeleidt hen door het proces.

- Claims behandelen. Je beoordeelt claims inhoudelijk en zorgt voor een efficiënte en correcte afhandeling, met oog voor zowel klant als organisatie.

- Meedenken in complexe dossiers. Je ondersteunt bij lastige casussen, bijvoorbeeld rond aansprakelijkheid of bij het opstellen van reacties op bezwaren.

- Samenwerken met Legal. Je schakelt met het juridische team bij ingewikkelde vraagstukken en werkt mee aan het verder verbeteren van interne processen

- Een tweede of derdejaars bachelorstudent of een masterstudent Verzekeringsrecht of Nederlands Recht heeft onze voorkeur. 

- Goede beheersing van zowel de Engels als Nederlandse taal. 

- Beschikbaar voor minimaal 2 of 3 dagen per week voor minimaal 6 maanden; 

Wat wij bieden 

Concurrerende vergoeding - We willen de besten aantrekken en behouden, daarom bieden we een compensatiepakket dat daarbij past.

Pensioenregeling - Deelname aan Insify’s pensioenplan, met 6% werkgeversbijdrage.

Reiskostenvergoeding - We helpen reizigers met hun woon-werkverkeer.

Hybride werken - Mogelijkheid om twee keer per week vanuit huis te werken. Als ervaren professional kun je remote werken en kom je af en toe naar kantoor.

25 vakantiedagen per jaar - (+ een extra dag op kerstavond als het een werkdag is!)

Abonnement op Alleo - 50 EUR (netto) maandelijks (op te sparen) budget om uit te geven aan wat je wilt - van sportschoolabonnementen tot UberEats!

Leuke events - Maandelijkse team drinks, kwartaal uitjes, lunch & learns, feesten, merch en FUN!

Bedrijfs MacBook - Krijg de beste laptop om je werk snel en efficiënt te doen!

Snelle carrièreontwikkeling - Er is geen betere plek om je carrière te ontwikkelen. Wij groeien en jij kunt met ons meegroeien! Interne leiderschapsprogramma’s en coaching.

Hoge mate van autonomie - Het is tijd om ECHT impact te maken!

Growth Manager (Berlin) 

Salary Range: €55K – €75k

At a Glance

You'll own a real book of business in the Turkish market. There is a sales and account-management motion. The size of the responsibility comes from top-line ownership. Quota chasing is not the job. You shape the work and execute it.

What You’ll Do 🎯

- Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth and expansion efforts in the Turkish market. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes.

What your first 90 days look like

- Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on.

- Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

- Days 61–90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book.

- Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Manager to Senior Growth Manager to Strategic Growth Lead and beyond.

What You’ll Bring 💡

- You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not collect a title. You have some professional experience, have had to figure things out independently and you liked it.

- You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be able to open a dashboard, spot something off, and ask the right questions.

- You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day.

- You speak Turkish on a native level, have ideally worked in this market before and understand the market specifics.

Bonus points if you: 

- Have some exposure to performance marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, or ARPU. If not, we'll get you there by week 2.

- Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role.

- Have used tools like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular, or want to learn.

- Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way.

- Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up background. We hire the for right thoughts. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days.

- Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

- Own Everything: Get It Done. When an advertiser drops 28 action items into your channel on Monday, you don't escalate. You triage, batch, and ship the 10 that matter by Friday. You don't ask for permission to fix obvious things.

- Take Initiative: Be Proactive. You spot the geo where the cap consistently under-fills. You ask the algo team why. You propose the test. You don't wait for someone to assign it.

Why Almedia? 🎁

- Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

description:
WHO WE ARE 

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO 

- Build the machine that builds the machine . Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

- Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology . Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

- Do work that matters, and see it grow . The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

- Make an impact you can point to . In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT 

You'll hold Proxima Fusion's site development portfolio together as one program, spanning projects such as Stellaris, our manufacturing and testing infrastructure, and other site development work. Working closely with the project managers who lead each project, you'll make sure feasibility, key partner relationships and permitting strategy are handled coherently across the portfolio. Without this role, projects risk optimizing for themselves while the issues that cut across them fall through the gaps.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 

- Lead Proxima Fusion's site development program across multiple parallel projects, owning feasibility, key partner and stakeholder relationships, and permitting strategy

- Work closely with the project managers leading each site, aligning their schedules, budgets and deliverables to a single program roadmap

- Define and run the program's decision-gate structure, from initial project approval through to final investment decision, including deliverables, readiness levels, and cost and schedule tracking

- Represent Proxima Fusion to site owners, utility partners and other key stakeholders, building constructive, diplomatic partnerships across sites with different contexts and regulatory histories

- Own the permitting landscape across the portfolio, including radiation protection law, environmental permitting, building permits and other approvals where relevant, and sequence parallel approval processes into one coherent strategy

- Build organizational and infrastructure scaling plans that look beyond near-term needs, from initial capacity towards multi-GW scale

- Report program status, risks and key decisions to senior leadership

WHO YOU ARE 

- Extensive experience leading greenfield or brownfield energy or industrial site development programs through to final investment decision, ideally on former or adjacent nuclear sites or other heavily regulated sites

- A track record of managing multiple projects in parallel at different stages of maturity, using a structured, gate-based approach

- Skilled at building productive relationships with incumbent site owners and utilities, and comfortable working within formal, process-driven stakeholder cultures

- Able to pull together detailed technical requirements from engineers and specialists without needing a deep engineering background yourself

- Fluent in German and English, which the regulatory and stakeholder landscape requires

- Comfortable building program structure from scratch in a fast-scaling, first-of-a-kind environment

INTERVIEW PROCESS 

- Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

- Technical Screening (30 min)

- Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

Today, Eight Advisory has grown to 950+ employees (including 115 partners) in France, the UK, Belgium, Netherlands, USA (New York), Spain, Germany and Switzerland. Together with the Eight International Network, counting over 650 employees in more than 20 countries, we respond to a growing demand for financial advice from private equity firms, medium- and large-sized corporates, and investment banks. 

We are currently looking for an ambitious and diligent individual to join our Strategic Valuation & Modeling team in Munich as a Senior.

In this role, you will work with experts in the field of valuations, transformation, restructurings and transaction services, but will mainly focus on:

- Performing and reviewing complex valuation models;

- You value companies, intangible and tangible assets as well as strategic alternatives in connection with tax, transactional and accounting matters.

- You provide support with fairness opinions to assess the appropriateness of transaction prices and structure

- Identifying and understanding the key business drivers and provide value to the client through our services and the deliverables we produce;

- Managing the preparation of deliverables including reports, presentations and discussions with the different stakeholders; and

- Steering and providing guidance to more junior team members

To ensure that we find the best candidate for this position, we expect our future Senior to have :

- A Master’s degree in economics, engineering, business administration, or business economics

- Financial analytical skills and good accounting knowledge are considered as a prerequisite as well as giving meaning to the numbers and translate this into a well-structured report

- Between two to four year’s relevant professional experience in valuations, corporate finance investment banking or corporate development/strategy

- An entrepreneurial mindset and a hunger to be exposed to challenging projects

- A drive to solve new issues in a practical and creative manner

- Fluent in MS Office (especially with Excel and PowerPoint)

- Prior experience in developing and managing more junior professionals is preferred

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to be a great team player

- Fluency in German or English

- Eagerness to work on cross border assignments

If you meet the above requirements and are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

Feel free to reach out if you have any questions or need further clarification.

title: Senior Account Executive - Airline or Airline Catering (Europe, 100% remote)
description:
Join our fully remote, mission-driven team dedicated to pioneering sustainable inflight service management . Work on innovative technology solutions with global impact, collaborate within a diverse, international environment, and continuously enhance your skills through ongoing learning opportunities.

Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland with team members across 11 countries, we offer a dynamic and engaging company culture that celebrates creativity, collaboration, and inclusion.

About the role 

We are on a mission to contribute to a zero-waste future by drastically reducing food waste, fuel consumption, costs, and most importantly, CO₂ emissions in the airline industry. Every role in our company is a direct contributor to this vision and as a Senior Account Executive, you will be at the heart of the team that makes it possible.

You will report directly to one of the founders and work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, Product Management, Customer Success, and the broader founding team.

This is not a traditional SaaS sales role focused on high-volume transactions. Our customers are airlines, our sales cycles are complex, and our relationships often span many years.

You will be responsible for building and executing strategic sales plans, identifying and developing new opportunities, and managing enterprise sales cycles from initial engagement through to contract signature.

Rather than relying solely on inbound demand, you will proactively identify target airlines, build stakeholder relationships, and develop opportunities through a structured account-based sales approach.

We are looking for someone who has already built pipeline, navigated complex airline buying processes, and personally closed significant enterprise business. You will bring both the experience and confidence to independently lead opportunities while collaborating effectively with founders and subject matter experts throughout the sales process.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. While you will mentor and coach junior sales colleagues, your primary responsibility is generating pipeline, advancing opportunities, and winning new business. If your primary motivation is managing teams rather than selling, this role is not going to be a good fit.

Key responsibilities 

Strategic Enterprise Sales 

- Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to contract signature

- Develop and execute account-based sales strategies for airline customers

- Build relationships with executive and senior stakeholders

- Lead commercial negotiations and enterprise procurement processes

- Create and maintain strategic account plans

Pipeline Generation & Market Development 

- Identify and pursue new growth opportunities with airlines globally

- Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities

- Develop stakeholder maps and engagement strategies

- Generate opportunities through industry networking, referrals, partnerships, and events

- Continuously expand LimeFlight's presence within the airline industry

Commercial Leadership 

- Lead by example through active pipeline creation, opportunity management, and enterprise sales execution

- Mentor and coach junior sales team members

- Support deal reviews, account planning, and opportunity strategy

- Share best practices for enterprise sales execution and stakeholder management

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of sales methodologies and commercial processes

Cross-functional Collaboration 

- Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Implementation, and Founder teams

- Coordinate internal resources throughout the sales cycle

- Ensure customer requirements are clearly understood and communicated internally

- Support smooth transitions from sales into implementation and customer success

- Act as the voice of the market and customer within LimeFlight

Key competencies 

- 10+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, including significant experience selling to airlines

- Proven track record of generating pipeline through strategic account-based selling

- Demonstrated success selling enterprise software, SaaS, or technology solutions to large airline organizations

- Track record of personally leading and closing enterprise opportunities with a combined contract value exceeding CHF 3 million

- Experience managing six- and seven-figure enterprise sales opportunities

- Strong understanding of airline buying processes, stakeholder management, and enterprise procurement

- Ability to independently drive opportunities forward within complex stakeholder environments

- Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

- Strong commercial and business acumen

- Collaborative mindset with a team-first attitude

- Passion for mentoring and developing others

- High degree of ownership, accountability, and resilience

Strongly Preferred 

- Direct experience selling SaaS or enterprise software solutions to airlines.

- Existing network within the airline industry

- Deep understanding of airline operations and organizational structures

- Experience selling across different global markets, with the ability to adapt sales strategies and stakeholder engagement approaches to regional business cultures and buying processes.

- Experience coaching or mentoring junior commercial team members

Language 

- Fluent English required

- Additional languages are a plus

Expected travel needs 

You should be willing to travel up to 30% of the year for customer meetings, industry conferences, trade shows, and relationship-building activities.

Given the relationship-driven nature of the airline industry, regular face-to-face interactions are an important part of the role.

Hiring Process 

- Recruiter Screen (45 mins)

- Interview with Hiring Manager (1 hour)

- Technical Interview (1 hour)

- Discussion with founder(s) and peer(s)

LimeFlight is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. 

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work.

Join us and be part of a team committed to shaping a zero-waste future for aviation, where your ideas and passion truly matter.

Let’s talk!

Schließe dich Valiantys an und werde Teil von etwas Außergewöhnlichem!

Stell dir nun vor, du begibst dich auf eine spannende Reise mit Valiantys und Atlassian – eine Reise, auf der Innovation keine Grenzen kennt und dein Beitrag im Mittelpunkt steht.

Als Principal Transformation Consultant übernimmst du eine strategische Rolle beim Aufbau wichtiger Kundenbeziehungen, bei der Umsetzung komplexer Transformationsprogramme und beim Ausbau unseres Geschäfts.

title: Senior Account Executive – DACH
description:
